verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API with an API docs section and copy-pasteable curl examples, plus Python and JavaScript library guides, so runnable examples exist in a static form. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or try-it console, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the usual paths. missing for 10: interactive API explorer or in-browser 'try it' console, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of the reference's quality.
